# fader U123 printed appearance

Rear potentiometer/LED-number/ANALOG/SK6812/PORT.B/pin diagram. Clear actual operating-side photo is unprinted; marketing 0V/3.3V callouts are not added as front ink.

Included as high-resolution reference-redrawn PNGs. The artwork contains freshly drawn text/shapes and no product photograph pixels or crops. Exact source URLs/image hashes, final raster hashes, sizes, support parts and registrations are in `artwork.json`. Raw reference photos, private lookup, generators and intermediates are excluded from the repository. M5Stack marks and original designs retain their respective rights; these are reference reconstructions rather than production artwork.

- back: [https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/fader/fader_02.webp](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/fader/fader_02.webp); SHA-256 `88dae225dd6d20a6ebb007c43b28786d74c6534c67c97bfebc12b2afe14fe0f8`.
- unprinted operating side: [https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/fader/fader_03.webp](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/fader/fader_03.webp); SHA-256 `dcc55bbd84d819f1a92ece4884d69964b625581b6118578c0a8bd42784eb7182`.

Surface coverage and registration:

- back: printedFilm on `Fader native rear shell`, [16.8, 44.4] mm, center [0, 7.5, -5.012] mm. Continuous exact-product adhesive label spans native rear service aperture; PCB/potentiometer remain behind it.

All panels use `artworkKind: reference-redraw`. `artwork:false` disables every printed panel. No originally unprinted cap, lever, slider grip or button is given fictional ink; all registered graphics belong to their actual fixed shell/platform/terminal support. Actual continuous adhesive films retain the original native openings underneath, independently of the existing physical PCB/mechanism assemblies.

`sticker-smoke.json` confirms finite/nonempty registered geometry, exact before-change physical vertex/normal/index/material/world-transform signatures, unchanged original component state/API and driven motion, terminal-plug variants where applicable, and Grove four-wire attach/pose/detach. The original source geometry, controls and connectors are unchanged. Colours, typography and layout are reconstructed from photographs and fitted to native label recesses, not production-print data. Browser pixel inspection remains deferred; stage stays modeled. No other readable printed face is currently identified in these exact references; molded marks and unreadable manufacturing stamps are not redrawn.
